product: Managed agent memory and sessions are in Beta
tagline: Managed agent memory and managed agent sessions are in Beta.
what_it_does: Managed agent memory and managed agent sessions are in Beta. Databricks now provides two fully managed, Lakebase backed stores for agent state, both usable from agents built on any framework: Managed agent memory gives agents durable, long term memory that persists across conversations, with semantic search. Managed agent sessions store durable conversation history that an agent reads at the start of a turn and appends to as it runs.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
